contribution_requirements: Next.js 16.4 breaking changes: `params` and `searchParams` are Promises (await in server components, React.use() in client components). No `<head>` tags in layouts — use Metadata API. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code.
key_patterns: 1) 'use client' at top for client components (useState, useEffect, useRouter). 2) Server components are plain async functions — no directive. 3) CSS: Tailwind 4 utility classes + inline style={{ ... }} with --db-* CSS vars. 4) All --db-* tokens defined in app/globals.css. 5) apiClient from app/lib/api/client.ts handles auth token injection + 401 refresh automatically. 6) Auth context: useAuth() from app/lib/auth-context.tsx — provides { user, isLoading, setUser, signOut }. 7) Auth gate pattern for client components: check user + isLoading then redirect via useRouter if unauthenticated. 8) BookingStatus in dashboard/types/index.ts uses lowercase: 'pending'|'confirmed'|'checked_in'|'checked_out'|'cancelled'|'no_show'. 9) ApiBookingStatus in app/lib/api/bookings.ts uses UPPERCASE: 'HELD'|'CONFIRMED'|'CHECKED_IN'|'CHECKED_OUT'|'CANCELLED'|'PAYMENT_PENDING'|'NO_SHOW'|'PENDING'. 10) Normalization mapping is needed: API uppercase -> dashboard lowercase. 11) overview/page.tsx is a server async component using connection() from next/server. 12) reservations/page.tsx and inventory/page.tsx are 'use client' components with useState. 13) rooms/page.tsx is a plain server component.
directory_structure: app/lib/api/ — API client modules (client.ts, auth.ts, bookings.ts, search.ts). New file: app/lib/api/dashboard.ts. app/dashboard/ — dashboard pages (overview, reservations, rooms, inventory). app/dashboard/types/index.ts — shared dashboard types. app/dashboard/mock/data.ts — mock data (shapes reference only; pages will stop importing from here). app/dashboard/components/ — shared UI components (StatCard, StatusBadge, DashboardTopbar). .agents/tasks/ — planner/reviewer artifacts (never committed).
